note: Schema for validating imported pre-existing human annotations. It does not request or authorize new human annotation.

requiredFields.positiveProduct18Labels: all Product-18 labels explicitly judged applicable
requiredFields.explicitNegativeProduct18Labels: Product-18 labels explicitly judged not applicable
requiredFields.uncertainProduct18Labels: labels explicitly marked uncertain or not adjudicable
requiredFields.annotationExhaustive: boolean indicating whether all Product-18 labels were considered
requiredFields.agreementOrAdjudication: agreement/adjudication status supplied by the source

admissionRules: At least one priority confusion pair has one label positive and the other explicitly negative, or the row is an accepted neutral/co-occurrence control.
Uncertain is never converted to negative.
Selective omission is never converted to negative.
Synthetic, LLM, and weak-consensus labels retain non-gold status and cannot satisfy this schema.
Rows lacking source grouping or underlying-text rights evidence are rejected.
